title: German Kielbasa Stir Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful German-inspired stir fry featuring kielbasa sausage and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Heat the Fry in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced kielbasa sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for about 5-7 minutes, or until they begin to tenderize.
Sprinkle the Nutty German Seasoning over the top and stir to combine.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
